references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the total number of women who had not had sexual relations with a man is mentioned as 32,000. Verse 46 states that half of these, 16,000 people, were given to the congregation.
This verse also mentions 16,000 people as part of the distribution and shows how the spoils were divided between the warriors and the congregation.
Describes how the Israelites took Midianite women and children captive, which is the background for the counting of people in verse 46.
Gives instructions to take women, children, and livestock as spoils of war against distant cities, reflecting the practice described in Numbers 31.
